## Core competencies
- Retrieval-Augmented Generation: chunking strategies, embeddings, hybrid search, re-ranking, PageIndex
- Agent evaluation and reliability: Braintrust LLM evals, Pydantic AI schema validation, Mem0 contextual memory
- Agent orchestration: LangGraph state machines, tool/function calling, structured outputs, Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Multimodal AI: Google Gemini Vision Pro for image-grounded reasoning
- Voice AI: speech agents and conversational simulation on Vaani Research Labs APIs
- AI-native product: Next.js 15 App Router, React 18, streaming responses, TypeScript
- Backend and data: Node.js, Express, Python, Streamlit, PostgreSQL, Prisma, MongoDB, Supabase, Redis
- Fundamentals: data structures and algorithms (1000+ problems solved), system design

## Selected projects
- VaaniVerse — a voice-AI contact-centre simulator. AI customer personas with emotions, memory and hidden objectives roleplay live calls while an AI coach scores the trainee on empathy, active listening, ownership and compliance, with transcript-level QA breakdown and call replay. Built on Vaani Research Labs' voice APIs. https://github.com/ashusnapx/contact-center-simulator
- PostGen — multi-agent LinkedIn post generator; LLM prompt orchestration splitting content planning from tone adaptation. https://postgen-ashusnapx.vercel.app/
- AI Book Explorer — conversational book discovery and summarisation built on LangGraph and CopilotKit with Prisma/PostgreSQL. https://github.com/ashusnapx/ai-book-explorer
- GenAI Apps Generator — scaffolding tool that turns a described idea into a working AI app shell on Gemini Pro. https://genai-assignment.vercel.app/
- Know About Your Food — multimodal nutrition analysis with Gemini Vision Pro and Streamlit. https://know-your-food-ashusnapx.streamlit.app/
- AI Coal Mines Laws — grounded domain assistant over Indian coal mining regulation. https://dgms-gemini-ashusnapx.streamlit.app/

## Recognition
- TCS AI Friday, Season 2 (2026) — Rank 1 in the weekly hackathon, qualified for the semi-finals, advanced to the regionals. Project: **Nexus Cold Chain AI**, an agentic system for vaccine cold-chain safety. Three specialised LangChain agents (IoT sensor analyser, root-cause analyser, risk-prediction analyser) over a unified schema joining IoT telemetry, vehicles, warehouses, weather and mapping data; an ML risk model flagging shipments Normal / Partial / Critical; an incident-response layer returning repair time, nearest viable warehouse and packaging remedy; Gmail-MCP tool calling over OAuth 2.0 for notifications; PageIndex retrieval and Mem0 contextual memory; Braintrust for LLM evaluations and Pydantic AI for schema-validated outputs. Built with Vishnu Shanker Sharma, Shashank N U, Namratha S and Sachi Motghare.

- Vaani Research Labs hackathon / AI Learn Circle meetup (Jul 2026) — his first hackathon. He did not get the idea working inside the event window, pitched it to Tushar Shinde (co-founder & CEO, Vaani Research Labs), and built the working prototype, VaaniVerse, immediately afterwards.
